title: Avoid throwing error on model mistakes in SelectorGroupChat builtin selector
body: To make it work better with local models and small models.

linked_prs.title: fix: improve speaker selection in SelectorGroupChat for weaker models
linked_prs.body:
Don't throw an exception when model makes a mistake. Use retries, and if not succeeding after a fixed attempts, fall back to the previous sepaker if available, or the first participant. 

Resolves #5453

ai_judgment.response: Yes. The issue pertains to handling model mistakes in a selector, which involves LLM operation and potentially incorrect model output handling, aligning with the criteria for agent issues.
